title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "listProductsForCountry" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "(hash 94cc8f43)" → after: "List all products in a country, optionally filtering by brand, family, coin, payment method, or language"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
